turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Iyer from Lucknow?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, I am Anjali from the State Bank security team. I am calling to confirm if you just made a payment of nine thousand five hundred rupees?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh my goodness, yes, I did. Is there some problem with the transaction?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, no, everything is perfect. We just noticed a large amount and wanted to ensure it was actually you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I was a bit worried. Do I need to do anything to verify it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nothing at all, Mrs. Iyer. This is just a courtesy confirmation call for your safety.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. Some people told me that banks call to steal money these days.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: They are right to be careful. Please remember that the bank will never ask you for your OTP, PIN, or password over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That is a relief. I almost asked if I should tell you my details for the record.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please never share those details with anyone, even if they claim to be from the bank. We already have your records here.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you, beta. I will keep that in mind.
